steps.title: Portal Registration & DISCOM Verification

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.desc: Clear, verified answers to the most common questions regarding PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana.

list.q: What is PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana?
list.a: It is a central government initiative approved by the Union Cabinet with an outlay of ₹75,021 crore aimed at providing financial assistance to 1 crore residential households to install rooftop solar, enabling them to benefit from up to 300 units of free electricity every month.

list.q: Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?
list.a: Any Indian citizen owning a residential property with a suitable rooftop and an active domestic electricity connection with a local DISCOM is eligible. The applicant must not have previously claimed a central rooftop solar subsidy for the same meter.

list.q: How much central subsidy can a household receive?
list.a: In general states, the Central Financial Assistance (CFA) is ₹30,000 for 1 kW, ₹60,000 for 2 kW, and ₹78,000 for 3 kW. In special category states and UTs (North-East, Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, J&K, Ladakh, etc.), the subsidy is ₹33,000 for 1 kW, ₹66,000 for 2 kW, and up to ₹85,800 for 3 kW and above.

list.q: Is additional central subsidy available for systems above 3 kW?
list.a: No. The central subsidy is capped at 3 kW (₹78,000 in general states and ₹85,800 in special category states). You can install larger capacities if permitted by your DISCOM sanctioned load, but the central subsidy will not exceed this cap.

list.q: Can commercial establishments or offices apply for this residential subsidy?
list.a: No. The Central Financial Assistance under PM Surya Ghar is strictly reserved for domestic/residential consumers. Commercial, industrial, and agricultural connections are not eligible.

list.q: Do I need approval from my local electricity distribution company (DISCOM)?
list.a: Yes. Before commencing installation, you must submit an application through the national portal and receive technical feasibility approval from your DISCOM. After installation, the DISCOM must also inspect the system and install a net meter.

list.q: Can I choose any solar installation vendor?
list.a: No. To be eligible for the central subsidy, you must contract with a vendor who is registered and empanelled on the national portal for your specific DISCOM. Installations done by non-empanelled vendors cannot claim the scheme CFA.

list.q: When and how is the subsidy credited?
list.a: The subsidy is disbursed directly into the applicant's verified bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) within approximately 30 days after the DISCOM issues the Commissioning Certificate and you submit your bank account details on the portal.

list.q: What documents are required to apply?
list.a: Key requirements include your latest electricity bill showing your consumer account number (CA number), an active mobile number linked with Aadhaar, proof of identity/address, and a cancelled cheque or bank passbook copy displaying your bank account number and IFSC code.

list.q: Where and how can I submit my application?
list.a: Applications must be submitted exclusively through the official Government of India National Portal at pmsuryaghar.gov.in or through the official PM Surya Ghar mobile application.

list.q: Can I install solar panels first and apply for the subsidy later?
list.a: No. You must register and obtain technical feasibility clearance from your DISCOM on the national portal BEFORE installing the system. Retrospective claims for solar systems installed without prior portal registration and DISCOM approval are not eligible for subsidy.
